item.text: The Independent Commission Against Corruption prepared this organisational questionnaire to profile NSW public sector functions, corruption risks and prevention practices.
item.support:
conducting research to 
develop a profile of the functions, corruption risks and corruption prevention strategies 
within the NSW public sector.

item.text: It asks organisations to rate potential corruption risks and indicate whether those risks are managed adequately or need more attention.
item.support:
